mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_trace (trace_id, tenant_id, channel, question_preview, tool_calls, retrieved_docs, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, model, success, error_code) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{tenantId}, #{channel}, #{questionPreview}, #{toolCalls}, #{retrievedDocs}, #{latencyMs}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{model}, #{success}, #{errorCode})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_trace ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(success), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)), 0) AS avgLatencyMs, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens FROM ai_trace WHERE create_time >= #{since}
